summary: Teacher urges FCC to reject any proposal that would reduce, restrict, or sunset E‑Rate support, arguing that such cuts would disproportionately harm low‑resource schools and widen educational inequities.

claims.requested_action: reject proposals to reduce, restrict, or sunset E‑Rate
claims.argument: Cutting E‑Rate would disproportionately harm schools and students with the fewest resources, widening the educational gap.
claims.evidence_quote: ectfully urge the Federal Communications Commission to reject any proposal in this proceeding that would reduce, restrict, or eliminate E-Rate support and instead preserve and strengthen the program
